definition: The Sanskrit form of suññatā, used for emptiness or voidness in Buddhist doctrinal contexts.
notes: This record exists for the Sanskrit spelling only; the governed Pali headword is `suññatā`, which carries the policy and the sources. The record previously cited MN 121, which contains `suññatā` and no form of `śūnyatā`, so it counted as an orphan against a source that cannot demonstrate it. The citation was removed in the 2026-09-13 Wave 11 audit rather than repaired: a Sanskrit form has no Pali running-text anchor.
